Hey YC! 👋

I'm Joseph, co-founder of[ Syncly](https://syncly.app/social?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery) - we're building an AI social listening tool. Today, we're launching **Creator Discovery**, a new way for brands and agencies to find the right influencers by analyzing what's actually inside their content.

# **TL;DR:**

* 🎯 Describe your ideal creator in plain English – Syncly finds them by analyzing video content, not just profiles
* 🔍 Search by visual aesthetic, storytelling style, spoken mentions, and more - things no filter can capture
* 🚀 Discover organic brand advocates who mention you without tags or hashtags
* ⚡ What used to take hours of manual scrolling now takes seconds

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99264&key=user_uploads/971454/b5ed5c9d-8ded-464c-b93f-ff4ce144df33)

**Ask:** If you run influencer marketing at a brand or agency,[ try it free](https://social.syncly.app/login?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery) and tell us what you think. We'd love your feedback.

**Offer:** Book a demo through Launch YC, and we'll include a personalized social listening audit alongside your creator discovery walkthrough →[ Book a demo](https://syncly.app/demo?utm_source=launchyc&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=influencer-discovery)

<https://youtu.be/7d10K1GN3S8?si=Oyb3cKVln2etPi6K> 

---

# **❌ The Problem**

Influencer marketing is no longer a nice-to-have - it's a core growth channel. But finding the right creators is still painfully manual.

The current process looks like this: you open a platform, set some filters (follower count, category, location), scroll through hundreds of profiles, and then manually watch their content to figure out if they're actually a good fit. Does their aesthetic match our brand? Have they worked with competitors? Do they tell stories in a way that resonates with our audience?

These are the questions that matter most, and none of them show up in metadata.

Traditional discovery tools search profiles. They can tell you a creator has 50K followers in the beauty category. But they can't tell you whether that creator films in a warm, cozy bedroom aesthetic or a bright studio setup. They can't tell you that a creator mentioned your competitor's product in a GRWM last Tuesday, without a hashtag or tag.

---

# **🛠 How Syncly Solves This**

Syncly Social analyzes what's actually happening inside the content – every frame, every word, every sound. Instead of filtering by metadata, you describe what you're looking for in natural language, and Syncly finds creators whose content matches.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=99264&key=user_uploads/971454/5f564bfa-9007-4d33-8a16-a08eef2493ae)

### Here's what you can search by:

* **Visual mood & aesthetic** - "clean minimal apartment with natural lighting"
* **Creator persona** - "fitness-forward creator, athletic build, gym setting"
* **Content format** - "GRWM morning routine" or "before-and-after transformation"
* **Spoken mentions** - find creators who organically mention your brand in their videos, no tags required
* **Storytelling style** - conversational, educational, high-energy, or laid-back

launches.body:
Hi YC! We’re Sam and Jitesh, and we’re building [Eggnog](https://www.eggnog.ai/). We’re on a mission to enable everyone to create, share, and enjoy the magic of AI-generated videos with consistent characters.

Check out [the most popular video](https://youtu.be/WnAzSG9PFO8) made with Eggnog - it got 100k views on Twitter in 24 hours! Paul Graham even said it was funny!

### AI Videos don’t have consistent characters

AI videos exploded in the past year, and we saw a deluge of content that was funny, spooky, and whimsical. But one thing has held these videos back from really being ready for primetime – AI video creators can’t create scenes with consistent characters.

Creators try every trick in the book to give their wizard the same wizened face from one scene to the next, but no matter, the wizard always looks different.

Inconsistent characters kill so much of the magic of AI videos. It’s hard to get invested in the protagonist of a story if they look different in every scene!

### Eggnog

Eggnog gives creators the control to design their characters exactly how they imagine and lets them use those characters in cinematic scenes. This unlocks AI video creation that is immersive with characters that viewers get attached to.

Creators can also use and remix characters made by other Eggnog users, allowing creators to build worlds in a collaborative and social way.

We use a special mix of open-source diffusion models and post-processing to give creators control. Until now, the average creator couldn’t make a truly cinematic scene without a Hollywood budget for actors, sets, cameras, etc. Scenes from Interstellar, Dune, and Jurassic World were impossible to make without millions of dollars and months of time. But Eggnog changes that.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79488&key=user_uploads/587051/bc4cf951-1c5c-422f-9a80-46b6f92c4b1f)

### What’s next?

Character consistency is the foundation of entertaining AI video, but it’s only the beginning. We’re excited about a future where users can remix characters and scenes to build infinite storylines.

We’re going to make it possible for viewers to get engrossed in a cinematic universe and then expand on that universe in a collaborative and social way.

### Team

We’re excited to empower the most creative people to tell the best stories.

Hey everyone! We’re [Mark](https://www.linkedin.com/in/markbuckler/), [Justin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justinparus/), and [Diandre](https://www.linkedin.com/in/diandre-ruiz/) and we’re thrilled to introduce you to [Soundry AI](https://soundry.ai/): **a text-to-sound AI generator for musicians**. Our AI creates musical building blocks perfect for reducing friction in the music creation process.

# 

# 🦸‍♂️ The Team

All three co-founders are united in their love of music. After completing his PhD in AI at Cornell, Mark got his start in the music industry by founding the [Codex Collective](https://codexcollective.co/press-kit), a live music event production company in Seattle. Justin quickly joined, and all three founders met for the first time when Diandre came to Seattle to perform as [Bandlez](https://www.instagram.com/bandlez/), the music project he co-founded. Justin is an engineer extraordinaire, first cutting his teeth on large-scale data processing during his time at Microsoft Azure. Diandre is a professional musician who has performed all over the world and written music with big names, including [Shaquille O’Neal](https://open.spotify.com/track/2oCzWh04Rt4WBr7StVUCHe)!

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78937&key=user_uploads/1320080/71009b68-f2c7-400e-afbc-466111c5784a)

# **🔇** The Problem

Music production technology has become increasingly democratized over the years, but creating a piece of music that you are proud of is just as challenging as it’s ever been. These days, most music is made by combining multiple audio recordings of individual instruments (called music samples) into a full song. Music sample libraries are easy to use which has led to massive growth for companies who provide them ([Splice,](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/splice) [Output,](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/output) etc), but they have a few key issues:

* Professional music producers are often prohibited from using sample libraries due to [copyright strike concerns](https://www.theverge.com/2020/2/17/21140838/justin-bieber-changes-running-over-asher-monroe-synergy-splice-sample-melody).
* Amateur music producers feel a lack of authenticity when using sounds made by someone else and struggle to make meaningful changes to them.

Generative AI offers a unique opportunity to build music creation tools that are easy to use and offer fine-grained artistic control. Unfortunately, existing AI music platforms ([Suno,](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/suno-279f) [Boomy](https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/boomy), etc) offer very little customization and next to no ability to modify any generated output.

# **🎵** Our Solution

Our team at Soundry AI has led the charge by launching the first-ever text-to-sample generator. Our proprietary foundational latent diffusion transformer offers state-of-the-art audio quality due to the efforts of our research team and partnerships with leaders in electronic music production. As you can see in [the video below](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MT3k4VV5yrs&ab_channel=SoundryAI), musicians like Diandre can use our tool to create unique, high-quality, copyright-free samples perfect for their music projects.

This past week we released our newest product: [Infinite Sample Packs](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/fEfYkkon7YI). Now, all that a user needs to do is click a button to get accurate stylized sounds. Professionals have praised the quality and specificity of the sounds, and amateurs have been thrilled with the simplified interface.

# **📢** Call to Action

If making music is your thing, we’d love for you to try our sample generator [here!](https://soundry.ai/) We’d be so thankful if you to share our product with all of your musical friends, and if you have any questions then please reach out via [founders@soundry.ai.](mailto:founders@soundry.ai) We can’t wait to hear from you!

# **☕️ TL;DR**

* **Ape** is the ultimate **AI prompt engineer** 🐒, designed to optimize your prompts by reducing cost and latency while increasing performance.
* Ape achieves an **impressive 94.5%** on the GSM8K benchmark, surpassing Vanilla (54.5%), CoT (87.5%) and DSPy (90.0%).
* **Easy to set up evaluation**: Ape can auto-generate evaluation code and use LLMs as a judge, or you can use your own eval metrics.
* Get set up in less than 15 minutes and see the difference.
  * [Schedule a meeting](https://cal.com/team/weavel/weavel-onboarding) to discover more. Let's chat! 🙂

# **🔒 Problem**

You’re an engineer of an LLM app, trying to get the prompts just right. Every time you type something in, the output changes—so you tweak a word here and there, and it changes again. Sometimes the outputs looks better, sometimes not. But you’re never sure. Hours go by, all spent on prompt engineering.

Getting the outputs you want can feel like an endless game of trial and error. And you’re not alone. Over the past few weeks, we’ve talked to over 100 YC companies, and a lot of them are facing the same challenges:

* **Measuring output quality is hard** (You’re heavily relying on manual evaluations at the moment.)
* **Prompt engineering does not work as you want** (You hate spending 5-7 hours a day searching for that one great prompt.)

# **🔑 Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/ddf5778d-78d0-4ff2-a4aa-b84624aeebc0)

We solve the problem with one simple formula:

```
good input + right guidance = better prompts
```

Today, we launch Ape, your first **AI Prompt Engineer**. Inspired by DSPy, Reflexion, Expel and other research papers, Ape iteratively improves your prompts. Here’s how Ape works:

1️⃣ Log your inputs and outputs to Weavel (with a single line of code!)

2️⃣ Let Ape filter the logs into datasets.

3️⃣ Ape then generates evaluation code and uses LLMs as judges for complex tasks.

4️⃣ As more production data is added, Ape continues refining and improving prompt performance.

### **How to use**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/0c1eeedd-ac08-40e7-ad35-acff6766c2c1)

**Create a Dataset**

Change just one line of code to start logging LLM calls with the Weavel Python SDK. The SDK supports sync/async OpenAI chat completions and OpenAI structured outputs.

You can also import existing data or manually create a dataset.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/bdfc79bd-edeb-4dbf-8c9b-7d432007fa3a)

**Create a Prompt**

Write a prompt that corresponds to your dataset. You can add an existing prompt as the base version, or if you prefer, create a blank prompt and provide a brief description for Ape to create a prompt from scratch.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/1bfacea3-c2d9-4ac8-90d7-9a6d3e37fd60)

**Optimize Prompts**

To optimize your prompt using Ape, fill in the necessary information (e.g. JSON schema as you want) and then run the optimization process. An enhanced version of your prompt will be created and available soon.

Ta-da! It’s that easy. Ape outperforms with a remarkable 94.5% score on the GSM8K benchmark, surpassing Vanilla (54.5%), CoT (87.5%) and DSPy (90.0%). With Ape, you can optimize the prompt engineering process, saving tons of time and cost while increasing performance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/2002273/45b5ec84-f89d-4d57-9e20-ad349f521c97)

Ape is **open source**. [Check out our repository on GitHub.](https://github.com/weavel-ai/Ape) (We’d appreciate a star 🌟)

# **🚀 The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83213&key=user_uploads/1564365/201595e0-e85e-4931-81aa-a9947754b1b4)

From left to right: [**Jun**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jun-park314/), [**Andrew**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sounhochung/), and [**HyunJie**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hyunjiejung/) — together we’re building Weavel.

**Andrew** and **Jun** built 10+ LLM-based products, open-sourced a prompt engineering platform, and co-authored a paper at a NeurIPS workshop last year. **HyunJie** worked on data analytics and optimization at Chartmetric and DevRev, and focused on growth marketing at Liner.

# **TL;DR:**

Streamable makes sure many of the biggest IRL streams stay alive under poor network conditions.

# **The Main Problem:**

Without [Streamable.run](http://Streamable.run), streamers that stream outside and encounter poor network conditions, will disconnect from Twitch or Kick. Their stream will end, and their thousands of viewers get kicked from the stream. By the time they reconnect, most of their viewers have gone on to do something else.

Nang, being a streamer himself and being friends with many streamers, felt these issues firsthand and knew that all IRL streamers were frustrated with the current solutions available.

# **The Solution**

Cloud Hosted Streaming Servers. Our product sits in between the streamer and the streaming platform, which allows for a clean solution to many problems IRL Streamers face:

🔵 100% Stream Drop Protection: When a streamer encounters poor network conditions when streaming IRL, our system automatically switches their screen to display their most popular clips and let the viewers know that connection has been lost and that the streamer will be back soon. 

🔵 Remote Stream Management: Bigger streamers have remote teams that are not necessarily at the streaming location. The streaming server allows team members and moderators to edit and manage the stream from anywhere in the world.

🔵 Switch without ending stream: Without Streamable, streamers only have one input to their stream, causing them to need to end the stream in order to switch cameras (for example, switching from Desktop camera to IRL phone camera). With Streamable, they can switch cameras while livestreaming with a press of a button in our UI.

🔵 Collab Stream: Streaming platforms accept one input to the stream, making it impossible for streamers to share the same camera feed when collaborating. Streamable allows streamers to share inputs with other streamers with on-platform friend requests, so that all streamers can share the same camera easily.

# **Progress So Far:**

In the past 3 months, we’ve gotten a stable product that is the best on the market. We are also powering many of the biggest streamers and working with production teams for Adin Ross’ Brand Risk, Sperm Racing, FaZe Clan, EdwardKSo, etc. 

Through working with these streamers, we’ve discovered that the IRL streaming industry is growing extremely fast, has very underrated cultural relevance, and is currently extremely underserved. We believe streamers deserve so, so much better, and that’s what we’re here to do, starting with this first product!

🔵 Nang Ang is a top Twitch streamer in the Software & Game Development category and has a B.S.&M.S @ CMU in Computer Engineering. He has been sharing his startup and entertiaing projects on Youtube and Twitch, and has grown a community of over 200k followers and 30 million total views on social media.

🔵 Manav Bokinala has built across infrastructure, AI, and consumer products — from co-founding an AI-powered app builder, to architecting distributed systems for an AI GTM platform, to shipping a consumer social app. He's now focused on solving the hardest problems in live streaming infrastructure.

We're building an AI-native group chat app that helps you hang out with your friends more. Your AI agent (digipal) knows your location, calendar, relationship history, and photos. It talks with your friends' digipals to coordinate IRL hangouts automatically - suggesting times when everyone's free, finding nearby restaurants and coffee shops, making reservations with AI calls, splitting bills from receipts, and nudging you to share photo memories after hanging out. 

Right now, coordinating hangouts with friends takes too much effort. We're removing that friction so you can spend less time planning and more time actually having fun IRL.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/7bae7c14-2266-4d71-82e2-f23716cf4f2a)

**Where We're Going - The First AI-Native Social Operating System**

Digipals work through AI widgets that pop up right in your group chat when you and your friends need them. Talking about dinner? The restaurant widget appears. Someone sends a receipt? The bill split widget shows up. You never have to leave the group chat to coordinate.

We're starting with widgets that make it easier to hang out IRL - restaurant reservations, movie/concert suggestions, flight/hotel bookings, bill splitting, and sports scores. Here's some sneak peeks:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95189&key=user_uploads/1557194/91296545-05f9-4057-b324-b600168547b9)

Then we're adding widgets that help you stay close to your friends and make new ones - relive memories from fun times together in the past, post memes/articles/reels your group would actually find funny, surface life updates worth celebrating, and connect with friends of friends.

Eventually, anyone can build AI widgets for Digipals. Your group chat becomes the social operating system, and the widgets are the apps that enhance human connection.

**Team**

[Peggy](https://www.linkedin.com/in/peggy-wang-ai/) cares deeply about human relationships. For over nine years, she's grabbed dinner monthly with the same friends at Madras Cafe in Sunnyvale - the restaurant their group chat is named after. She's a second time founder who worked on the Metaverse at Meta Reality Labs, where she believed that the future of social connection was in virtual worlds and games. Now, she's convinced the future is simpler - it's showing up IRL.

Mathew made a hit solo game called [deadshot.io](http://deadshot.io) which has over 2M+ monthly active users. He enjoys connecting with others through playing music and video games, and joined the team to help make the future a little less lonely for everyone.

launches.tagline: Clone winning organic and paid ad video/slideshows
launches.body:
Hey YC!

We're Alisa and Stephen.

Super excited to introduce Bluma - the all in one platform for AI UGC that clones winning organic and paid ad video/slideshows.

It allows you to remix content with a built in video editor and node-based canvas workflows.

We are the first to crack de-editing - cutting each scene, removing and then adding back on caption, text and on screen image popups.

No need to switch between different models and creative platforms to compile clips/assets.

**Problem**

UGC is very time consuming and requires recruitment, week long back and forths and expensive retainers/per video fees.

Oftentimes for both organic and paid, the best way to find a format is to copy adjacent competitors and remake their script/visuals exactly.

The whole process end to end is extremely long and expensive, ranging from researching, briefing, sourcing, reviewing, editing, making variations and distributing.

**Solution**

We believe that AI footage is getting and will continue to get so good that both will converge and be indistinguishable. As such, we can help bring together the whole marketing stack into one platform where all you need is a really good prompter and taste.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/abcdeafe-fa89-4ddc-a571-70e9c7b880e5)

Let's say you want to recreate a winning UGC skincare ad. You can first take the URL and automatically de-edit each scene, captions, text and photo overlays. Then, you can use our asset maker to recreate all the shots exactly.

Then you can save all your workflows as templates in our node based canvas.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/758866c5-48a3-47c4-b396-723ed16f203f)

We allow you to split screen to work between assets and editing seamlessly - including a creative agent and capabilities like auto captioning.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/dc015a6b-b975-47ed-94bf-ae78dfe24ae2)

You can also clone slideshows and create multiple variations in one canvas.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=98704&key=user_uploads/2724981/cf3abd59-aede-4eb9-a48c-0033bd3c007c)

**Our ask**

We'd love for you to try out our product! It is still in beta and any type of feedback is greatly appreciated. There is no waitlist or paywall and you can try starting today at <https://www.getbluma.com/>.\

Hey all - this is [Alisa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/wu-alisa/) and [Stephen](https://www.linkedin.com/in/stephen-ni/) from Bluma!

**TL;DR** Bluma automates your entire consumer marketing strategy with content templates - a library of automated video workflows that turn scripts and assets into finished videos at the click of a button.

[https://youtu.be/Pi69Jd-fnok](https://youtu.be/Pi69Jd-fnok%5C)

\
**Problem**

If you’re building in consumer, you know that it is super hard to get eyes on your product.

In a post-AI world, attention is the most valuable commodity. Social media is only growing faster and faster, and we're still early.

Short form has a high barrier of entry due to cost (UGC costs $35/video + $1 CPM, editors are $50/video) and operations as shown below:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95662&key=user_uploads/2724981/ade8a7fd-4114-4164-ae5c-f0b389922684)

**Solution**

Instead of manually assembling a video in CapCut, Bluma works like this:

1. Create template format by chatting with AI
2. Generate videos on autopilot
3. Push traffic to product/service

Our biggest client runs 8 templates across 16 accounts, posting 2x daily. Bluma is growing 100% w/w and went from 0 to 28k MRR in 4 weeks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95662&key=user_uploads/2724981/c5fd4e08-2eb3-4c12-80ea-bcf74db92c92)

Using templates, we can replicate proven formats and A/B test scripts for you cheaper, faster and more scalable than human creators (UGC, editors).\
\
**Our Vision**

Make video effortless and accessible to anyone through (video automation) templates.

**Team**

Alisa was the youngest engineer at 19 working on self-driving at Zoox. Stephen scaled payment infrastructure to millions at Shopify. Having generated over 6.7M views and been featured on New York Times, we have taste for scalable virality.

We met 3 years ago when we snuck into the Collision Tech Conference and spent the entire summer building in WeWork offices before both heading into the University of Waterloo. Dropped out and planned to bootstrap until we applied 21 days late and went into YC F25.
